audit_item: A13/A14 / gamma half-life and legacy Train diagnostic JSON integrity
finding: The frozen discount half-life training/evaluation plans, run manifests, bundles, completion receipts, and source plans were permissively parsed. The low-capacity and zero-target plan generators also permissively read their frozen baseline plan and candidate bundle. Duplicate keys could change the interpreted scope or candidate identity even when a raw-file digest matched.
change: Added recursive duplicate-key JSON readers with stable DataError boundaries and object-root checks to both discount half-life runners and both legacy diagnostic plan generators. Their persisted input reads now use those readers. Expanded synthetic malformed JSON regressions across all six readers.
